messages.author: 118ad936abe03634
messages.subject: rankdef parameter in besag model
parts:
Hi INLA users, ond doubt,  what is the function of constr and rankdef parameter in the besag model.
When I run inla.doc("besag") , it says "if
adjust.for.con.comp=TRUE then constr=TRUE is interpreted as a sum-to-zero constraint on each connected component in the graph and the rankdef parameter is set to the number of connected components". I cant figure out exactly the meaning of this parameters.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] rankdef parameter in besag model
parts:
the constr=T will impose a sum-to-zero constraint or constraints,
according to the value of adjust.for.con.comp.

its written up here

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1877584517301600?via%3Dihub


if you cannot download it, there is preprint on arxiv.org

note that we need scale.model=TRUE otherwise, little make sense.

H
